questions.question: Q: Conjugate "spielen" in the present and perfect tenses for "ich" and "er/sie".
questions.correctAnswer: Present: ich spiele, er/sie spielt. Perfect: ich habe gespielt, er/sie hat gespielt.

questions.question: Q: When do you use sein vs haben as the auxiliary in the perfect tense?
questions.correctAnswer: Use sein for: (1) verbs of movement (gehen, fahren, laufen, fliegen, kommen), (2) verbs of change of state (aufwachen, sterben, werden), (3) sein and bleiben. Use haben for all other verbs (most verbs). Key test: does the verb involve moving from A to B or a change of state? If yes → sein.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about forming and using the present, perfect (perfekt) and imperfect (präteritum) tenses; when to use each. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, modal verbs, separable verbs); show precise grammar (cases, word order, adjective endings); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge about DACH countries; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (außerdem, jedoch, trotzdem, zusammenfassend). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
